text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's sold out here too... This is the fifth<n>bookstore
already!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Every time a new volume comes out,<n>the series
just gets more and more<n>popular...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, what should I do? It's almost time<n>for training...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's 2.2 kilometers to the bookstore at<n>the next
station over... If I use the<n>Uma lane, it should only
take two<n>minutes...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I really hope they have it!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Mejiro Dober fails to find<n>the manga
she wants and continues<n>her search instead of
coming to<n>practice.
